blocks.rationale: The failed parent expressly gives the preliminary legal intermediate that Bob satisfies §152(c)(1). A reusable producer converts that given qualifying-child basis into dependent status under §152(a), and a connected terminal skill applies §152(b)(1) when the dependency year and queried year coincide. This targets the failed parent while leaving the already-correct §151(c) parent to its existing fallback.

inputs.name: expressly_given_dependent_basis
inputs.question: What dependent basis is expressly given for the individual: qualifying_child, qualifying_relative, both, or none?

inputs.name: dependent_year
inputs.question: What taxable year is expressly associated with that given qualifying-child or qualifying-relative status?

skill.intent: Determine dependent status under §152(a) from an expressly given qualifying-child or qualifying-relative intermediate, while preserving its stated taxable year.

outputs.description: Whether the expressly given basis makes the individual a dependent under §152(a).
outputs.name: is_dependent

outputs.description: The taxable year attached to the given dependent basis.
outputs.name: dependency_year

fields.name: expressly_given_dependent_basis
fields.question: Do the facts expressly give qualifying-child status, qualifying-relative status, both, or none?

fields.name: dependent_year
fields.question: Which taxable year do the facts expressly attach to that status?

reads.question: Extract the expressly stated §152 qualifying status and its taxable year from the current facts without independently deciding eligibility.

origin.quote:
For purposes of this subtitle, the term "dependent" means-

    (1) a qualifying child, or

    (2) a qualifying relative.

source_obligations.statement: An individual is a dependent if the individual is a qualifying child or a qualifying relative.

source_provenance.quote:

inputs.name: is_dependent
inputs.question: Is the individual a dependent under §152(a) for the relevant year?

inputs.name: dependency_year
inputs.question: For which taxable year was the individual determined to be a dependent?

inputs.name: question_year
inputs.question: For what year does the current question ask whether §152(b)(1) applies?

inputs.name: claim_is_affirmative
inputs.question: Does the current question affirm that §152(b)(1) applies, rather than assert that it does not apply?

skill.intent: Answer whether §152(b)(1) applies to an individual who is a dependent in a taxable year beginning in the same calendar year as the queried year.

outputs.description: The native Entailment or Contradiction answer to the current §152(b)(1) proposition.
outputs.name: answer

fields.name: question_year
fields.question: Which year is named in the proposition?

fields.name: claim_is_affirmative
fields.question: Does the proposition say that §152(b)(1) applies?

reads.question: Extract the queried year and literal polarity of the current §152(b)(1) proposition.

origin.quote: If an individual is a dependent of a taxpayer for any taxable year of such taxpayer beginning in a calendar year, such individual shall be treated as having no dependents for any taxable year of such individual beginning in such calendar year.

source_obligations.statement: Section 152(b)(1) applies when the individual is another taxpayer's dependent for a taxable year beginning in the same calendar year, treating that individual as having no dependents for the individual's taxable year beginning in that calendar year.

source_provenance.quote: If an individual is a dependent of a taxpayer for any taxable year of such taxpayer beginning in a calendar year, such individual shall be treated as having no dependents for any taxable year of such individual beginning in such calendar year.
